gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with clinically diagnosed malignant brain glioma in an important structural area (WHO Grade IV);

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with poor postoperative effect or ineffective guidelines for conventional treatment

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To investigate the expansion, infiltration and persistence of Vγ9Vδ2 T cells after reinfusion.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To investigate the immunological dynamics of Vγ9Vδ2 T cells after reinfusion.

agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic gamma-delta T cell therapy (cell therapy)
arms: To evaluate the safety and feasibility of allogeneic Vγ9Vδ2 T cell therapy.
To evaluate the therapeutic effect of allogeneic Vγ9Vδ2 T cells on brain malignant glioma
To investigate the expansion, infiltration and persistence of Vγ9Vδ2 T cells after reinfusion.

coder_notes: Cell therapy only. Temozolomide/radiotherapy are optional in some patients ('may be combined'), not a registered intervention, so not listed. Three EXPERIMENTAL arms are really objectives of one single-arm study; internal/external control groups are described but not registered arms. Conditions include DIPG and medulloblastoma; eligibility is WHO grade IV malignant glioma, ages 4 and over. Biomarker exploration is generic, no specific marker named.
